about: The workflows e2e/mobileSweep.spec.js walks by touch (Prompt 283), at a phone (375 x 812) and a tablet (768 x 1024), in English and in Spanish: the ten student workflows of ACCESSIBILITY_CONFORMANCE.md and five instrument workflows. Each is a few real taps, an observable result and no sideways scroll. tests/touchTargets.test.js holds this list to the spec's. `sizes` lists where a long computation runs: the cluster fit runs at the phone in English and at the tablet in Spanish, so both sizes and both languages are covered without four fits.

workflows.name: Start from the front door and open an investigation
Run and change a sandbox scenario: open the scenario browser
Work through an investigation: read and go on
Measure in an observation and read a plot: a tap on the plot selects
Open an observation in the Observatory
Use the Sky Lab to plan an observation
Run an experiment and read its results
Finish and export one's own work: My work
Save an item for later from the Library
An image measurement: place a mark by touch
A photometry batch: measure all marks
A spectrum line measurement: fit H-beta for a velocity
A porkchop choice: compute the window and choose a cell
